title: Inside Apple Software Design

reader_summary.headline: What was it like to build and demo new things for Steve Jobs?
reader_summary.overview: What was it like to build and demo new things for Steve Jobs? How did Apple develop the software components of iconic hardware products like iPhone, iPad, and more? And what can we learn from these stories? In this wide-ranging conversation from April 2019, A16Z's Frank Chen sits down with Ken Koseanda, a longtime software engineer and designer at Apple.

key_points.text: In this wide-ranging conversation from April 2019, A16Z's Frank Chen sits down with Ken Koseanda, a longtime software engineer and designer at Apple.

thesis: The episode explores how Apple developed the software components for iconic hardware products like the iPhone and iPad, specifically focusing on the history of creating their own web browser. It details Ken Koseanda's career path from a freelance photographer and motorcycle mechanic to a software engineer at Apple, highlighting his work on the Safari browser and the company's strategic shift to control critical technologies under Steve Jobs.
